title: Mobile Reliability, Farm Search & Municipality-Scoped Sales
summary: Closed the latest mobile and farming regressions while removing the largest avoidable payload from the public property lookup. The shared mobile workspace menu now carries its own stylesheet and host-page isolation so it reopens consistently after navigation; mobile property cards use the available phone width with cleaner Compare/overflow spacing; Farm Map autocomplete now groups live New Jersey ZIP, county, municipality and address matches; and verified-sales lookup requests are reduced from an entire county file to the current four-digit municipality district through a cached server endpoint with safe fallback.

items.detail: Removed excess dashboard header space on phones, made property imagery fill the mobile card width, and separated Compare from the overflow control.

The shared sidemenu fragment now loads the mobile-menu stylesheet on every workspace page and isolates menu links/buttons from host-page CSS so reopening after navigation preserves the intended sheet layout.

Autocomplete now merges NJ geocoder suggestions and candidates with local county prefix matches, groups results as ZIP Codes, Counties, Towns & Municipalities, and Addresses & Places, and retains coordinates for reliable selection.

The browser captures the municipality district from the official NJ parcel response and routes the later verified-sales request through /api/sales-by-district. The server filters the bundled county source to that municipality, caches the result at the edge, and falls back to the legacy county file if the scoped endpoint is unavailable.

The latest Vercel deployment is READY; production sidemenu, mobile-menu CSS and Farm Map autocomplete assets return HTTP 200 with the new release code, and Vercel runtime telemetry records successful HTTP 200 execution of /api/sales-by-district.
